profile.name: Idir Yacine
biography: I’m Yacine, a fullstack and ML/AI engineer and tech lead. I don’t sell a framework, I sell outcomes: shorter time to market, teams that ship more, and hard problems that stop being problems.

Today I lead a team of three engineers at Infraxcode, owning product discovery, technical direction and delivery of an AI developer-tools product. Before that I co-founded Hader and co-led its team of five developers, led and delivered three projects at Ibdapro including a government-grade platform, and delivered consulting projects for AnFashion, Zawya and Dive Club. My PhD in deep learning for medical image analysis brings research-grade rigor to everything I ship.
If you need an idea taken to production, fast, let’s talk.
